phone.changelog: v2.9.3: Add Bluetooth internet setup for watch apps, a phone network settings shortcut, and watch-reported internet status with refresh and stale-report handling. Sharing requires device Bluetooth tethering/PAN support.

watch.changelog: v2.9.3: Add Internet from phone setup, live verified Bluetooth internet status, and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi settings shortcuts. Enable Android Bluetooth tethering and paired-phone Internet access on supported firmware.
